round: implemented-calendar-release (independent final review of KyCalendar stage 06, PR #79 head 95be60c)

reviewer.role: independent review sub-agent, Claude Code in T3 Code; did not implement, commit, push or open PRs

blind.procedure: Read the AGENTS chain, SKILL.md, rubric and design contract, then the stage-06 after manifest. Viewed all 30 unique representatives at full resolution, plus one KyPost (kypost-05-after-inbox-desktop-light) and two KyMessages captures (kymessages-06-after-users-desktop-light, -mobile-light) only to judge suite_cohesion. Scores frozen and hashed before reading implemented-calendar-final-*, kycalendar-implementation.md, kycalendar-06-gates.json, implemented-post-messages-scores.json or product source. Light and dark of each surface scored identically after viewing both.

rubric.rounding: per file: Decimal(str(x)).quantize(Decimal("0.1"), ROUND_HALF_UP) of the exact Decimal weighted sum; ky_fit the same of the 5-dimension mean; means from unrounded weighted sums, reported half-up to 2dp
